JoinPage.title: Join your group
JoinPage.intro: Your teacher gave you a short code (like {example}). Type it below to start.
JoinPage.comeBack: If you close this tab and come back later, just paste the same code again — it's valid for 30 days. Lost the code? Ask your teacher.
JoinPage.teacher: Are you a teacher? <link>Sign in here.</link>
JoinPage.rateLimited: Too many tries. Try again in {seconds}s.
JoinPage.atCapacity: This group is at capacity for today. Try again tomorrow or ask your teacher.
JoinPage.unknownCode: Code not found, expired, or revoked. Ask your teacher for a fresh code.
JoinPage.wrongSite: Codes only work on the site they were created on. You are on {where} ({host}). Check the address with your teacher.
